root_cause: The recovery classifier evaluated cancelled Required as FAILED_GATE_RECOVERY before evaluating behind-main state. A PR could therefore enter main drift, have its stale Required attempt cancelled, and remain stuck with required checks expected instead of refreshing the same leased lineage.
prevention: When the latest canonical Required attempt is cancelled, no newer Required is active, and behindBy is greater than zero, classify the PR as MAIN_DRIFT_RECOVERY. The existing terminal-writer lease and zero-overlap supervisor guard then refresh the same PR lineage from one captured current-main SHA. Genuine Required failures remain fail-closed.

safety.terminal_writer_lease: required by supervisor before branch refresh

historical_replay: A behind-main PR whose latest canonical Required attempt is cancelled and has no newer active Required must become MAIN_DRIFT_RECOVERY.
A behind-main PR whose latest canonical Required attempt concluded failure must remain FAILED_GATE_RECOVERY.

evidence.observed_failure: main drift -> cancelled Required -> branch protection reports required checks expected
controls: terminal writer lease required before same-lineage refresh
